in_marathi.name: Nipun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nipun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nipun means 'deep' or 'intense'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Vishnu, symbolizing the deep and profound qualities of the deity.
